newsitem.title: GERMANY: Degussa shares power ahead on Veba news.
newsitem.headline: Degussa shares power ahead on Veba news.

text.p: Shares in German chemicals and precious metals group Degussa AG rose 4.70 marks to 81.0 marks in early IBIS trade on Wednesday on news that Veba was acquiring a 36.4 percent stake in the firm.
Veba, a diversified utitilities group, said earlier that it would buy Chemiewerte mbH, which had held the stake in Degussa, for 2.9 billion marks, making it Degussa's biggest shareholder.
Shares in Veba also made a spirited start to the session after the news, trading up 1.08 marks to 99.60 in early IBIS business.
While Veba stock had settled back slightly by 0654 GMT to trade 0.98 marks higher at 99.50, Degussa shares continued their rally, trading 5.10 marks higher at 81.40 by the same time.
